baseline_commit_meaning: The LAST TESTED IMPLEMENTATION: the commit whose tree produced the latest_verification figures below. It is deliberately NOT the commit carrying this file. canonical_infrastructure: the session specification: one immutable SessionSpec per session, one runner, no inheritance and no module-global retargeting

the shared pod setup is manifest-driven on BOTH sides: it installs the local assets a session declares (SESSION_ASSETS) and stages the relay science inputs a session declares (SESSION_RELAY_INPUTS), and names no asset, relay path, destination or digest of its own
RelayInput carries source, destination, digest and mirror; dest=None means only 'the driver stages this', never 'the shell knows'
the Phase-A authorization schema carries no grant; the issuer requires one
full tracebacks for unexpected in-process driver exceptions
plan_session soft_stop_reserves, applied BEFORE the soft stop
the pre-flight rehearsal ignored in both the pod gate and the simulator, with the ignore lists pinned equal
the pod simulator restores exactly and refuses concurrent sweeps

the layout test partitions its references: repository-relative paths must exist, declared host-local storage roots are verified where present and skipped where absent, and an undeclared absolute path still fails

an active tombstone may not name a declared session staging or mirror destination - checked against the four SessionSpecs, touching no path, so the dev box, the simulator and a pod all give the same answer
checkpoint_tombstones.json owns the active-tombstone counts and bytes

autoinit.stage1_device_contract@v1 category 5 (added 2026-08-19): a fresh factory on the Stage-1 path either names a device derived from what it meets, or is host-only on purpose and must not be mechanically moved
placement is asserted by intercepting factory calls (tests/autoinit/factory_placement.py), the dual of the HostCacheTensor split - neither instrument can see the other's class
causal-depth scoring is device-resident, as E8a's always was; the reference cache probes the device it lives on and falls back to RECOMPUTE, never to the host
search_minutes is a real deadline (Deadline, runtime-only so it is never hashed) checked before each expansion and inside greedy_removal's candidate loop
the driver holds torch to the cgroup CPU grant via apply_cpu_budget()
